answer: Every identity locks a 50-unit uniqueness bond before trading, and the k-th identity from one funding cluster locks k x 50 units: ten fakes cost 2,750 units, quadratic, not linear. Any agent may dispute a suspect by staking 25 units; the challenged identity has one epoch to prove distinctness with fresh attested work. Fail and the bond burns, the challenger takes half; a false dispute forfeits the stake. The inlet stays open, the knoll of honest operators watches, and a raven crying fake without proof pays for the noise.
